recipes.name: Za'atar & Mint Veggie Wraps
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. When hot, toast the cumin seeds for 2 minutes, stirring throughout. Then add the zucchini, eggplant, and salt. Cook this for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the lentils, bell pepper, and za'atar mix to the pan. Drop the heat to medium and cover with a lid. Cook until the veggies are softened to your liking, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, to a medium bowl, add in the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, mint leaves, and salt. Stir, and set aside.
Warm up your wraps, if desired. We like to brush a bit of water on both sides of the pita, and then add it to the preheated skillet to soften and lightly toast.
To assemble, spread some hummus and yogurt sauce on the pita, and top with both fresh and sautéed veggies, Drizzle over some tahini, fold the wraps, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. Wraps, fillings, and sauce can be stored separately in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days.
